confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Rio de Janeiro tourist areas (Copacabana, Ipanema, Leblon, Santa Teresa), brought forward to July 2026. No live listings, menus or city-price searches were used. Beer and restaurant anchors are the best grounded. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (roughly 2x and 2.2x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is least certain: rates vary widely by neighborhood and property and July is a busy period, so the 3-star anchor has the widest band. Local-currency prices were converted at an assumed mid-2026 real rate from general knowledge, not a checked live rate, so a large BRL move would shift all USD anchors proportionally. Restaurant anchors may or may not include the customary 10 percent service charge. The FX value comes from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was substituted. Anchors reflect direct general knowledge of Rio de Janeiro pricing, with cocktail and wine set relative to the beer anchor.
